_note: The Cosmic Web (WS-5d, RFC-039) — the largest scale in the /explore ladder: the foam of superclusters, filaments, and great walls wrapped around vast voids that structures the nearby observable universe (out to roughly 1 gigaparsec / a few billion light-years). A HEAVILY SCHEMATIC MODEL, NOT TO SCALE and NOT A SURVEY (PRD-030 principle 2 + RFC-039 Gpc-honesty risk): Laniakea sits at the origin as the 'you are here' anchor, and the great named structures are placed in an illustrative layout. Distances (dist_mpc) are real order-of-magnitude values; the xyz layout is hand-authored to convey the web's topology (nodes + walls + voids), NOT true positions. Treat it as a diagram of an idea, not a map.
_provenance: Structures + rough distances: NASA/IPAC NED; 2dF + SDSS redshift surveys (Sloan Great Wall, Gott et al. 2005); Boötes Void (Kirshner et al. 1981); Shapley Concentration; Horologium-Reticulum Supercluster. Schematic positions hand-authored. Science-review pending (WS-5d).
